title: helianthemum guttatum var. eriocaulon
intro: Helianthemum guttatum var. eriocaulon, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and exhibit antiseptic properties. Bioactive constituents of Helianthemum guttatum var. eriocaulon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
